spells/mark-wild-4878.name: Mark of the Wild
spells/mark-wild-4878.effectSummary: Animals no longer regard you as a threat and do not threaten or attack you unless you attack an animal first, which ends the spell immediately. Duration depends on your dragonmark: Least 1 minute per level, Lesser 10 minutes per level, Greater or Siberys 1 hour per level. Requires any true or aberrant dragonmark.

spells/marked-pulse-4879.name: Marked Pulse
spells/marked-pulse-4879.effectSummary: As an immediate action, deals force damage to creatures you select within the 20-foot-radius burst, with a Fortitude save for half. Damage depends on your true dragonmark: Least 2d6, Lesser 3d6, Greater 4d6, Siberys 5d6. If you have a Greater or Siberys dragonmark, a creature that fails its Fortitude save is also knocked prone.

spells/ray-retaliation-4881.name: Ray of Retaliation
spells/ray-retaliation-4881.effectSummary: When a ray attack hits you, you can cast this as an immediate action to negate that ray's effect and fire force energy back at its caster, provided you were aware of the attack and not flat-footed. The retaliation does not provoke attacks of opportunity, requires a ranged touch attack, and must penetrate the original caster's spell resistance if any. Damage depends on your dragonmark: Least 1d6 per 2 caster levels (maximum 5d6), Lesser 1d8 per 2 caster levels (maximum 5d8), Greater or Siberys 1d6 per caster level (maximum 10d6). Your ray has the original ray's range and can target only the original caster. Requires any true or aberrant dragonmark.

spells/spell-haven-4882.name: Spell Haven
spells/spell-haven-4882.effectSummary: Stores one spell you can normally cast with a casting time of 1 round or less inside your dragonmark. Only one spell can be stored at a time, and the maximum level depends on the mark: Least 1st, Lesser 3rd, Greater or Siberys 5th. The stored spell can later be cast as an immediate action and does not count against your normal daily spell limit. Required material components are consumed when the spell is stored, and the stored spell cannot be lost or stolen by effects that remove prepared spells or available spell slots. The focus is a Siberys dragonshard for a true mark or Khyber dragonshard for an aberrant mark, worth at least 500 gp per level of the stored spell. Requires any true or aberrant dragonmark.

spells/taunt-dragon-4870.name: Taunt Dragon
spells/taunt-dragon-4870.effectSummary: Targets one dragon that has line of sight to you and can see you. On a failed Will save, whenever it does anything other than attack you or move to attack you, it takes a penalty on attack rolls, skill checks, and saving throws based on your true dragonmark: Least -5, Lesser -10, Greater or Siberys -20. The spell ends if line of sight between you and the dragon is broken or if you become disabled, dying, or dead. If multiple taunt dragon spells affect the same dragon, it takes the penalty only when it fails to attack or move toward the caster who affected it most recently.
